# Metron — Daily Energy, Readiness, & Caloric Allowance

> Open-source, headless-first fitness computation. An exploratory TDEE estimator and unvalidated recovery coaching heuristic with a responsive static web interface. Caloric Allowance and direct wearable integrations are planned, not shipped.

## Start here
- [Continue in a new chat](./docs/CONTINUE.md): recovery order, verified checkpoint and next task
- [README](./README.md): public premise, feature status, and local demo
- [Agent instructions](./AGENTS.md): build commands and non-negotiable invariants
- [Machine manifest](./metron.manifest.json): structured capabilities and paths
- [API](./docs/API.md): executable ESM/CLI examples and contracts
- [Science and limits](./docs/SCIENCE.md): equations, assumptions, citations

## Research and contribution
- [Research Lab](./research/README.md): published limited RMR results, open questions and proposed studies
- [Durable evidence program](./research/robustness/README.md): current H0–H8 gates, applicability, freshness and reconstruction
- [Gate and weakness state](./research/robustness/plan.json): authoritative execution order
- [Research claim corpus](./research/robustness/corpus.json): stable claim, context and source records; clinical review incomplete
- [H1 inventory](./research/robustness/H1_INVENTORY.md): declared denominator, explicit applicability matrix and field semantics
- [H2-B resting-equation evidence](./research/robustness/h2b/README.md): exact variants, source discrepancies, bounded population findings and preserved G3
- [H2-A readiness evidence](./research/robustness/h2a/README.md): bounded source review, contradictions, unsupported exact rules and H5 wording candidates
- [Machine-readable study plan](./research/protocol.json): planned A/B/C comparator and evaluation criteria
- [Research agenda](./docs/RESEARCH.md): falsifiable questions
- [Research protocol](./docs/RESEARCH_PROTOCOL.md): wearable prediction study proposal
- [Future architecture](./docs/FUTURE_ARCHITECTURE.md): proposals, not current capabilities
- [Contributing](./CONTRIBUTING.md): how to challenge or improve models
- [Documentation index](./docs/INDEX.md): complete navigation

## Key technical locations
- `core/model.js` — source-of-truth implementation
- `core/model.d.ts` — TypeScript declaration
- `schemas/input.schema.json` and `schemas/output.schema.json` — machine-readable I/O
- `bin/metron.mjs` — JSON CLI
- `examples/` — nonpersonal fixtures
- `tests/` — deterministic software tests

Note: llms.txt is an informal community proposal, not an official guarantee that any agent or search engine will read this file. This file is a curated pointer map; read linked source contracts for exact behavior.
